en.title: The boundary API: three endpoints, zero hand-written SQL
en.shortdesc: The /query contract, the manifest version, and how a self-hosted MetricFlow server hot-reloads its truth without downtime.
en.longdesc: Part 3 of a series on building a semantic-layer report engine: the Semantic Layer API in detail — the selection request, the Arrow/JSON response, manifest_version as a safety belt, and the dbt-runner loop that keeps the engine current.
en.seoTitle: The boundary API: three endpoints, zero hand-written SQL
en.seoDescription: Designing the Semantic Layer API: /metrics, /catalog, /query, manifest versions and hot-reloading a MetricFlow engine. Part 3 of a series.
